purpose: Prove the open Agent-neutral demand-driven human-Agent collaboration quality harness through goal-level natural-task dogfooding, dynamic capability discovery and lifecycle arbitration, an accepted methodology and open quality-conformance profile, and thin cross-host reference adapters that reuse sufficient external protocol, runtime, identity, audit, provenance, and evaluation layers.

increments.observedProblem: The first native Codex plugin lifecycle attempt needed a repository .tmp marketplace source, and that source itself falsified G4's no-residue floor; the existing Hook-only projection therefore has no durable repository-owned discovery entry through which Codex can materialize it without first polluting the repository.
increments.hypothesis: One committed workspace marketplace entry marked AVAILABLE and pointing only to the existing adapters/agent-autonomy-harness-codex projection will let Codex 0.147.0 discover the optional plugin from a clean checkout without installing or activating it, turning later materialization into a native Codex lifecycle while preserving the repository-as-product and CC-Switch-independent boundaries.
increments.falsifier: Codex rejects the workspace-relative adapter path, discovery installs or enables the plugin automatically, the entry makes the repository root the plugin payload, a separate manager or user-operated setup becomes required, the entry creates conventional residue, or validation requires moving or expanding the thin projection.
increments.stopCondition: Stop after one marketplace entry is either discovered by the fixed Codex 0.147.0 CLI as available but not installed from a clean repository, with targeted and canonical checks passing, or is rejected and removed; record zero O1-O5 progress, restore an empty ready graph, and leave no temporary or consumer residue.

deliverables: one optional workspace marketplace entry that exposes only the existing thin Codex projection from a clean checkout
